data.goal: Compare lung-enriched and skeletal-muscle-enriched proteins in the Human Protein Atlas, defining both cohorts strictly by RNA tissue specificity = Tissue enriched and the named tissue in RNA tissue specific nTPM. Use consensus RNA nTPM as abundance. For each cohort report its size, the share of FDA approved drug targets and the share secreted to blood, and report intersection size and Jaccard. Select the ten members of each cohort with the highest nTPM in its own tissue, ties by Ensembl ID, and …

items.text: Identify lung-enriched cohort (RNA tissue specificity = Tissue enriched, tissue = Lung)
Identify skeletal-muscle-enriched cohort (RNA tissue specificity = Tissue enriched, tissue = Skeletal muscle)
Cohort summary table: size, FDA-approved drug target share, secreted-to-blood share for each cohort
Intersection size and Jaccard index between the two cohorts
Top-10 lung-enriched genes by lung nTPM (ties by Ensembl ID), with nTPM in both tissues and main subcellular locations
Top-10 skeletal-muscle-enriched genes by skeletal-muscle nTPM (ties by Ensembl ID), with nTPM in both tissues and main subcellular locations
Cohort-composition bar chart (FDA target share and secreted-to-blood share per cohort)
Two-tissue abundance heatmap (selected 20 genes × lung & skeletal muscle nTPM)
Consensus interaction edges among the union of selected genes (undirected, deduplicated, no self-edges)
Degree per selected gene within the union
Degree bar chart for selected genes
Interpretation: summary of findings

limitations: The interaction analysis is limited to consensus edges recorded in the HPA interaction_consensus table; absence of an edge here does not exclude a physical interaction documented in other databases.
Subcellular location data for the lung cohort (a5) had rows for only 6 of 17 genes; the 11 missing entries reflect absence from the subcellular_location source table, not a biological absence.

The Jaccard index of 0 reflects strict tissue-specificity definitions (RNA tissue specificity = 'Tissue enriched' with the named tissue in RNA tissue specific nTPM); a relaxed definition could yield overlap.
